name: Knott's Hotel Thirty Acres Kitchen Scrambled Eggs, Sourdough Toast, Roasted Chicken & Salmon
brandOrRestaurant: Thirty Acres Kitchen at Knott's Hotel (Buena Park · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Right at the Knott's Hotel steps from the park entrance, Thirty Acres Kitchen serves a calm sit-down breakfast (eggs any style, bacon, sourdough toast, oatmeal, pancakes) and dinner (herb-roasted chicken, salmon, mashed potatoes).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Start your park day here with two scrambled eggs, bacon/turkey sausage, and sourdough toast or buttermilk pancakes before entering the park.
watchOuts: Ask for noboysenberry seeded compote on pancakes/waffles
